verses.en: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.sm: Atua e, aua neʻi e le tali mai, aua foi ne4 e mapu. Auā faauta, ua vava0 o e ua ita ia te oe;

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.sm: o e ua ‘ʻinoʻino foi ia te oe, ua latou faamaualuluga. Ua latou togafiti faalilolilo i lou nuu,

verses.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.sm: ma Jatou taupulepule ¡ e ua natia e oe. Ua latou faapea ane, O mai ia,

verses.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.sm: ia tatou faaumatia i latou ja le toe fai ma nuu; ia le toe manatua lava le igoa o Isaraelu. Auā na latou taupulepule ma le loto gatasi;

verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.sm: ua latou fai le feagaiga e tetee atu ia te oe; o fale je o Etoma ma sa Isamaeli; o Moapi ma sa Hakarà;

verses.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.sm: o Kavala, ma Amoni, ma Amaleka; o Filisitia atoa ma e ua nonofo i Turo;

verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.sm: o Asuria foi ua faatasi ma i latou; ua ʻaia i latou ma fesoasoani i le fanauga a Lota.

verses.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.sm: Selā. Ia e fai ¡a te i latou e faapei ona e faia ja Mitiana, ma Sesera,

verses.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.sm: ma Iapino i le alia o Kisona. Na faaumatia i latou i Enetoro; na avea i latou ma otaota mo le laueleele.

verses.en: Which perished at En-dor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.sm: Ia e faia o latou alii ia pei o Oreva ma Seeva;

verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.sm: ia pei o Seva ma Salemuna foi o latou alii uma; o e na faapea ane, Ia tatou fai mo i tatou o raea e afio ai le Atua.

verses.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.sm: Loʻu Atua e, ia e faia i latou ia pei o le mea faataavalevale ;

verses.en: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.sm: ia pei o le aputi o saito e lelea i le matagi. la pei o le afi ona susunu le vao matua,

verses.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.sm: ia pei o le mumi o le afi ona faamu a mauga;

verses.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.sm: ia faapea ona e tuliloa ja te i latou i lou afa, ia e faaatuatuvale ja te i latou i lou asiosio.

verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
verses.sm: la e matuā faama ia te i latou; ina ia latou saili i lou suafa, le ALII e.

verses.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.sm: Ia faamaina i latou ma ja faaatuatuvaleina i latou e faavavau faavavau lava; ia masiasi i latou, ma ja fano i latou;

verses.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.sm: inaia Poa e i latou, o oe, e ou le suafa o le ALII, na O oe lava o le Silisili ese i le lalolagi uma.
